_about: Known advisories assessed as not exploitable here, or accepted until a named fix. tools/dependency_audit.py fails CI on any advisory not listed, and on any entry past its review_by date. Changing this file is a security decision: say why in the commit.

exceptions.title: Next.js self-hosted applications vulnerable to DoS via Image Optimizer remotePatterns configuration
exceptions.assessment: Image optimiser is switched off (images.unoptimized) and no remotePatterns are configured.

exceptions.title: Next.js HTTP request deserialization can lead to DoS when using insecure React Server Components
exceptions.assessment: APPLIES: App Router / React Server Components request handling is in use. Mitigation is the Next.js 15.5+ upgrade (docs/SECURITY.md, open item). Until then, availability risk accepted by the product owner is REQUIRED — this exception is provisional.

exceptions.title: Next.js: HTTP request smuggling in rewrites
exceptions.assessment: No config rewrites; exposure limited to the middleware path rewrite. Residual until upgrade.

exceptions.title: Next.js: Unbounded next/image disk cache growth can exhaust storage
exceptions.assessment: Image optimiser is switched off (images.unoptimized); no disk cache is written.

exceptions.title: Next.js has a Denial of Service with Server Components

exceptions.title: Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution on windows-hosted servers

exceptions.title: Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when AVIF files are used
exceptions.assessment: Image optimiser is switched off (images.unoptimized), so the AVIF path is unreachable.

exceptions.title: Prototype Pollution in sheetJS
exceptions.assessment: APPLIES in the browser when a user opens a workbook in the Studio mapping preview. Fixed builds are published only at cdn.sheetjs.com, which this build environment cannot reach. Fix: install https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz from a machine that can, and commit the lockfile.

exceptions.title: SheetJS Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
exceptions.assessment: APPLIES client-side only (a user's own browser tab). Same fix as GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6.

exceptions.title: Minerva timing attack on P-256 signing
exceptions.assessment: Pulled in by python-jose. Tokens are signed HS256 only (JWT_ALGORITHM); no ECDSA key exists or is used, and verification is unaffected by the advisory. Upstream will not fix. Removal: replace python-jose with PyJWT (open item).
